job.text: You pasted a coffee order into your AI and asked it to "summarize this order." You need to drop the result into a spreadsheet with columns item · size · price.

preview.text: one large oat latte, four fifty

text.plain: Answer in exactly this format: item, size, price — one value each.
text.tech: Return JSON with exactly these keys: item (string), size (string), price (number).

text.plain: Write price as a number like 4.50, not words.
text.tech: price must be a numeric type, not a string.

text.plain: Please make it nice and friendly.
text.tech: Please make it nice and friendly.

rules.claim: item: oat latte · size: large · price: 4.50
rules.feedback: That's a receipt. Three named fields, and a price you can add up. You could paste this straight into a sheet.
rules.lesson: A fixed shape is what makes an answer checkable.

rules.claim: item: oat latte · size: large · price: four fifty
rules.feedback: Almost — the shape is right, but price is still words. A column of 'four fifty' can't be summed. Pin price to a number.
rules.lesson: A field being present isn't the same as being usable.

rules.claim: Sure! You got a large oat latte, and that comes to four fifty. Enjoy!
rules.feedback: Still a sentence. 'Friendly' and 'expert' changed the words, not the shape. You still can't paste this into three columns.
rules.lesson: Tone doesn't make an answer checkable.

output.answer: Sure! You got a large oat latte, and that comes to four fifty. Enjoy!

hints.nudge: A receipt always lists the same few things. What are they?
hints.gap: The AI gave you the words but not the shape. Which chip asks for item, size and price as separate values?
hints.moves: Add Name the shape and Make price a number. Leave the friendly/expert chips out.

whatYouDoDifferently.naive: "Summarize this order" → a sentence you can't check.
whatYouDoDifferently.rewrite: "Answer in exactly this format…" → three fields you can paste and add.

template.plain: Give me the answer in exactly this format: [field 1], [field 2], [field 3] — one value each. Write any amount as a number like 4.50, not words.
template.tech: Return JSON with exactly these keys: [key 1], [key 2], [key 3]. Numeric fields must be numbers, not strings.

notes: ChatGPT: paste your text, it returns the fields; ask for a table and copy it.
Copilot in Excel: ask it to put each field in its own column so you can total price.
A chat AI that can't run code: still works — a shape is just how you tell it to answer; copy the fields into your sheet.
